questions.question: List the title of all cartoons in alphabetical order.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Title FROM Cartoon ORDER BY title

questions.question: How many cartoons were written by "Joseph Kuhr"?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Cartoon WHERE Written_by = "Joseph Kuhr";

questions.question: What is the number of cartoones written by Joseph Kuhr?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Cartoon WHERE Written_by = "Joseph Kuhr";

questions.question: list all cartoon titles and their directors ordered by their air date
questions.gold_sql: SELECT title ,  Directed_by FROM Cartoon ORDER BY Original_air_date

questions.question: What is the name and directors of all the cartoons that are ordered by air date?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT title ,  Directed_by FROM Cartoon ORDER BY Original_air_date

questions.question: List the number of different series names and contents in the TV Channel table.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT series_name) ,  count(DISTINCT content) FROM TV_Channel;

questions.question: How many different series and contents are listed in the TV Channel table?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT series_name) ,  count(DISTINCT content) FROM TV_Channel;

questions.question: What is the Package Option of TV Channel with serial name "Sky Radio"?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Package_Option FROM TV_Channel WHERE series_name = "Sky Radio";

questions.question: How many TV Channels use the English language?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM TV_Channel WHERE LANGUAGE = "English";

questions.question: List the language used least number of TV Channel. List language and number of TV Channel.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT LANGUAGE ,  count(*) FROM TV_Channel GROUP BY LANGUAGE ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: List each language and the number of TV Channels using it.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT LANGUAGE ,  count(*) FROM TV_Channel GROUP BY LANGUAGE

questions.question: What is the series name of the TV Channel that shows the cartoon "The Rise of the Blue Beetle"?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.series_name FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN Cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T2.Title = "The Rise of the Blue Beetle!";

questions.question: What is the title of all the cartools that are on the TV Channel with the series name "Sky Radio"?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.Title FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN Cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T1.series_name = "Sky Radio";

questions.question: List top 3 highest Rating  TV series. List the TV series's Episode and Rating.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Episode ,  Rating FROM TV_series ORDER BY Rating DESC LIMIT 3;

questions.question: What are 3 most highly rated episodes in the TV series table and what were those ratings?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Episode ,  Rating FROM TV_series ORDER BY Rating DESC LIMIT 3;

questions.question: What is the maximum and minimum share for the TV series?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT max(SHARE) , min(SHARE) FROM TV_series;

questions.question: When did the episode "A Love of a Lifetime" air?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Air_Date FROM TV_series WHERE Episode = "A Love of a Lifetime";

questions.question: What is the weekly rank for the episode "A Love of a Lifetime"?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Weekly_Rank FROM TV_series WHERE Episode = "A Love of a Lifetime";

questions.question: What is the name of the series that has the episode "A Love of a Lifetime"?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.series_name FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN TV_series AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T2.Episode = "A Love of a Lifetime";

questions.question: List the Episode of all  TV series showed on TV Channel with series name "Sky Radio".
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.Episode FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN TV_series AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T1.series_name = "Sky Radio";

questions.question: What are the countries that are not playing cartoons written by Todd Casey?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT country FROM TV_Channel EXCEPT SELECT T1.country FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T2.written_by  =  'Todd Casey'

questions.question: What is the pixel aspect ratio and country of origin for all TV channels that do not use English?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Pixel_aspect_ratio_PAR ,  country FROM tv_channel WHERE LANGUAGE != 'English'
